## Intellectual contribution

Describe what *substantive philosophical change* this proposal makes. Link affected claim/challenge IDs.

## Strongest objection

What is the best case against this change? What remains unresolved?

## Evidence and attribution

Cite sources actually consulted. Disclose relevant AI assistance. Distinguish evidence from speculation.

## Privacy and rights checklist

- [ ] No private chats, memories, identifying stories, emails, or personal records
- [ ] Publication approved by the relevant human contributors
- [ ] I have the right to license this material under the repository's chosen license
- [ ] Change reviewed for private facts and inadvertent identifying clues
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate.py` passes for catalog changes

**External contributions require maintainer review before merging.**
